22K likes, 311 comments - loganpaul on October 17, 2026: "BUCKET LIST ✅ 1 in 8192 odds!

Last month I got the bug (and had the time) to cross “catching a Shiny Pokémon” off my bucket list. I chose one of the original games on the original cartridge, Pokémon Gold, because I wanted to experience what it might’ve felt like to randomly find one as a kid. No hacks, no cheats… just time, effort, and a ton of Max Repels

And wow, what a moment…

On October 29th, 6p EST I’ll be evolving Shiny Onix into Shiny Steelix LIVE on my YouTube channel while I break open $400,000 in Pokémon boxes and peel $800,000 in Unpeeled Corocoro 223 sheets as I continue to hunt for my PSA 10 Pikachu #1 😏

Oh and we’ll be joined by @dwarfmamba @heybigmike @jakepaul and @alecmonopoly 

Save the date and tune in!! 🗓️
October 29, 6p EST LIVE on my YouTube channel".

13K likes, 475 comments - loganpaul on September 26, 2026: "In this video we compare the value of opening a ~$13,000 Sun & Moon Team Up Booster Box to opening $13,617 of Pokemon Alpha Packs on Ripit.co

Every collector knows the reality of opening sealed product can be brutal. From hoping you pull the card you want, paying the grading fees, waiting for months, then crossing your fingers you get a 10. 

@Ripit aims to deliver a better experience for collectors by creating a seamless, enjoyable, one-stop-shop shop for your favorite cards in Pokemon, Basketball, Baseball and Football. More value, no waiting, no grading fees, transparent odds, instant buybacks, and pure entertainment. 

Use code RIP20 for 20% off your first purchase on packs up to $100 on Ripit.co

*Note that the 30.4% figure compares the estimated value of the graded cards against the total cost of the box + grading all 396 cards in order to most accurately determine the value of the cards. Even if the grading were free, the number would be 53.6% of total cost compared to Ripit’s 96.5% estimated market value relative to cost.

*These are results from one comparison; individual pack results vary. Estimated market values of the cards in the Box based on Card Ladder/Card Hedge data as of August 13, 2026 and may change*

@loganpaul is a co-founder of Ripit (18+)".
